notes.title: Update Information Ver. 1.08A (2016/10/4)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7307013/7803d686caab795cac8aab7774ffba63f528658f.png[/img]
Update Ver.1.08A enables the free-to-play version of Dead or Alive 5 Last Round. 
With the free-to-play version, the number of playable characters and Story mode specifications has been modified.
In order to use locked characters and play the Story Mode separate DLC purchases are required.
People who have purchased Dead or Alive 5 Last Round can continue to play the full game.

tags.feature: Update Ver.1.08A enables the free-to-play version of Dead or Alive 5 Last Round.
